name: doubt-driven-development

tests.prompt: Review this security change to the auth middleware — I need an adversarial second pass
Debug this hard-to-reproduce race condition in the fleet service — it only fails 5% of the time
Perform cross-model review of the database migration before it runs in production
This deletion workflow removes user data permanently — skeptically review the guardrails
I've tried 3 fixes for this bug and none worked — apply systematic diagnosis

notes: Use for security changes, irreversible operations, cross-model review, and hard bugs.
